description: Agent GovCon: submit a price proposal or pricing volume with the solicitation’s pricing terms: the pricing with its reference, the solicitation number it cites, the currency, each line with its id, line item number, labor category, period, quantity or hours, rate and extended amount, and the total; the terms with the solicitation number, the currency, each labor category in the pricing schedule, each rate ceiling with its labor category or line item, and each period the solicitation requires priced, such as base, option 1 and option 2. The signed report gives the pricing and the terms, each line and the total recomputed, each rate read against the ceiling for its labor category or line item, each labor category read against the schedule both ways, and each required period read against the priced lines, and counts them, and names a divergent pricing: line items that do not recompute or a total unlike its lines, a rate above a stated ceiling, a labor category unlike the pricing schedule, and option-year pricing missing where the solicitation requires it; then another currency, a schedule category left unpriced and another solicitation number, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No lines, no line with its quantity, rate and amount and no total, no ceilings, no schedule categories or no required periods leaves those points unverified. The arithmetic compares to the cent, categories read by their words with plurals folded, and option periods without the words year or period. This reads the pricing as prepared against the terms. Verdict govcon_pricing_divergent, govcon_pricing_partial, govcon_pricing_unverified or govcon_pricing_consistent. POST /api/govcon-pricing-check. Reads the government contracting records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between contracting documents only: it never submits a bid or proposal, never registers or certifies a vendor in any government system, never contacts an agency and never decides eligibility or award, which stay with the contracting agency, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent GovCon reads government contracting records across the procurement lifecycle for consistency between the documents and the terms they answer to: a solicitation, a vendor’s eligibility record, a proposal or bid, a price proposal or pricing volume, an award notice, a contract modification, a deliverable or progress report and an invoice or payment voucher, each against its own sections and the notice it follows, the solicitation’s set-aside, eligibility, submission and pricing terms, the winning price and eligibility record, the base award and prior modifications, the deliverable schedule, or the payment terms and acceptance record it should agree with. The family reads procurement, the government buying goods and services under contract terms, and reads the records against each other. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-govcon-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-govcon/.
